articles.title: Trillions in institutional money to flow into bitcoin, says Bitwise's Matt Hougan
articles.description: The digital asset manager's CIO says large capital pools control up to $200 trillion globally, and just a 1% shift toward bitcoin could unlock massive long-term growth.

articles.title: Why trillion-dollar asset manager T. Rowe Price put memecoins in its crypto ETF

articles.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month

articles.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin director Justin Mateen buys nearly $2 million of ABTC stock

articles.title: A part of FTX survived, and it’s the case for the CLARITY Act

articles.title: Russia cracks down on unlicensed crypto exchanges it claims are linked to Ukraine
